heading: Pull up a chair.
text: Three hosts, a lot of honest questions, and guests who are willing to go there.
photoAlt: The three unCOMFORTABLE hosts talking at the studio table under the neon logo
hint: Tap a name tag to meet the hosts

hosts.name: Eric
hosts.bio: Eric is the Director of Communications at Christ Community Church. He’s a pop culture obsessive, a gamer, and a bit of a contrarian. A self-described futurist, he’s usually first in line to try new tech and always up for talking through a big idea.

hosts.name: Alex
hosts.bio: Alex is a pastor, husband, dad of four, and commissioner of noon ball, a title he probably takes too seriously. He loves a good conversation and hearing people’s stories. Outside of church, you’ll often find him coaching his kids or figuring out what to make next on his 3D printer.

hosts.name: Jess
hosts.bio: Jess is a licensed counselor at CityCare Counseling. Her watchlist runs from Hallmark movies to true crime, and she has a knack for knowing when someone could use a word of encouragement.
